'''Eelo Begraas''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Working initially as a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]], Begraas later trained as a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], going on to become a legend throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The scrawny Bothan worked for seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] for the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]], although he was often loaned out to other organizations, including several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Begraas flew a customized [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], the [[Dicer (starfighter)|''Dicer'']]; with a distinctive [[Color/Legends|red]]-and-black appearance, its presence often caused opposing pilots to disengage and flee [[Starfighter combat/Legends|battles]] rather than face the Bothan.

==Biography==
A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Eelo Bregraas hailed from the Bothan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. While he was gifted in classic Bothan arts, he was driven to seek an alternate lifestyle by his flair for the dramatic and an addiction to adrenaline. As such, Begraas raced [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] at an early age and left his home [[Both system|system]] upon reaching adulthood to enlist in various military organizations. Moving from militia to militia, Begraas became an elite [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], earning a fearsome reputation that frequently preceded him. Begraas also customized his own [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] to make it more maneuverable, eventually naming the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the [[Dicer (starfighter)|''Dicer'']]. Begraas was rumored to have acquired prototype technology during one job for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], which he installed in his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="Troop Movements" />

Begraas was eventually recruited by the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]], from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Thaereian system]], where he became the top-ranked pilot and was employed as chief flight instructor and overall naval tactical adviser. He worked in this capacity for seven years, during which [[Time/Legends|time]] the Navy of Thaere rented his services to a number of other [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] militaries. This arrangement worked well for the Navy, both for the high price it could charge for the Bothan's services and because it kept Begraas&mdash;known for his short attention span&mdash;sufficiently entertained in his role that he remained working for the Navy.<ref name="Troop Movements" />

Begraas occasionally got into fights while planetside. However, he was often accompanied by his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R6-S1]], which he equipped with two mounted [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. Begraas nicknamed the droid "Shootfirst" and used the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to cover his escape from such fights. On two separate occasions, Begraas performed a strafing run over settlements where he was attacked. These incidents added to his reputation. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Begraas was sighted leading training missions near [[Morjakar]], a planet within the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Troop Movements" /> for which the Thaereian military was the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]-appointed protector.<ref name="Long Live the Republic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030508republic|text=Long Live the Republic}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Begraas was a scrawny Bothan with an almost comical physical appearance that made him appear unimposing, in stark contrast to his piloting persona. He had a permanent sniffle, forcing him to constantly wipe his nose. Begraas wore faded fatigues, rather than any specific military uniform.<ref name="Troop Movements" />

Begraas had a short attention span and was quick to anger. The Bothan thrived on adrenaline, which led to his pursuits of dangerous careers&mdash;first as a podracer, then as a starfighter pilot. He developed a fearsome reputation, which meant many opposing pilots went into hysterics when facing him and tried to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. This reputation was aided by his distinctive starfighter, which he painted black so as to blend in with the [[Star/Legends|stars]]. To this he added [[Blood/Legends|blood]] [[Color/Legends|red]] highlights and his personal insignia of a closed fist.<ref name="Troop Movements" />

Begraas could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bothese]], [[Caarimala|Caarite]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="Troop Movements" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eelo Begraas was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] in the article ''[[Troop Movements]]'', published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website. The article was a supplement for the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] campaign.
